atoms.exact_source_text: There is no Nursery Matter stock.
atoms.normalized_claim: There is no Nursery Matter stock.

atoms.exact_source_text: Nesting requires a suitable Residence-and-Care Place, civic margin, Caretaking and Teaching support, and reserved Sustenance equal to **ten times the eventual daily Sustenance drain per expected new body-unit**.
atoms.normalized_claim: Nesting requires a suitable Residence-and-Care Place, civic margin, Caretaking and Teaching support, and reserved Sustenance equal to ten times the eventual daily Sustenance drain per expected new body-unit.

atoms.exact_source_text: One Rabbit young represents one new body-unit, one Squirrel young represents one new body-unit, and two Mouse littermates together represent one new body-unit.
atoms.normalized_claim: One Rabbit young represents one new body-unit, one Squirrel young represents one new body-unit, and two Mouse littermates together represent one new body-unit.

atoms.exact_source_text: The daily Sustenance drain is reserved for the tuning phase.
atoms.normalized_claim: The daily Sustenance drain is reserved for the tuning phase.

atoms.exact_source_text: This is a preparedness commitment, not a recipe that manufactures offspring.
atoms.normalized_claim: Nesting is a preparedness commitment, not a recipe that manufactures offspring.

atoms.exact_source_text: New young then contribute to ordinary body-unit consumption.
atoms.normalized_claim: New young then contribute to ordinary body-unit consumption.

atoms.exact_source_text: Ordinary Expeditions contain **2–3 body-units**.
atoms.normalized_claim: Ordinary Expeditions contain 2–3 body-units.

atoms.exact_source_text: Three body-units is the standard ordinary maximum.
atoms.normalized_claim: Three body-units is the standard ordinary maximum for Expedition parties.

atoms.exact_source_text: This produces 2–3 Rabbits, 4–6 Mice, or 2–3 Squirrels before Guest and mixed-party adjustments.
atoms.normalized_claim: The 2–3 body-unit Expedition scale produces 2–3 Rabbits, 4–6 Mice, or 2–3 Squirrels before Guest and mixed-party adjustments.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Adopted.**
atoms.normalized_claim: BSA-08 — Special Artifacts is Adopted.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Special Artifact is a singular named Colony object.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Special Artifact is a singular named Colony object.

atoms.exact_source_text: It is not generic stock or a currency such as `Artifact ×3`.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Special Artifact is not generic stock or a currency such as Artifact ×3.

atoms.exact_source_text: Every Special Artifact has a concrete physical identity, provenance, a persistent location or custodian, and a limited set of credible uses.
atoms.normalized_claim: Every Special Artifact has a concrete physical identity, provenance, a persistent location or custodian, and a limited set of credible uses.

atoms.exact_source_text: It remains identifiable until it is used, exchanged, transformed, lost, or memorialized.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Special Artifact remains identifiable until it is used, exchanged, transformed, lost, or memorialized.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Special Artifact may enable a major Project, provide an irreplaceable component for a Tool or adaptive device, establish a Practice, satisfy a relationship or barter requirement, reveal knowledge, support a Tier-defining civic achievement, or carry durable historical meaning.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Special Artifact may enable a major Project, provide an irreplaceable component for a Tool or adaptive device, establish a Practice, satisfy a relationship or barter requirement, reveal knowledge, support a Tier-defining civic achievement, or carry durable historical meaning.

atoms.exact_source_text: An Artifact may later become a Tool or Keepsake through an explicit transformation, but it begins as a separate category.
atoms.normalized_claim: An Artifact may later become a Tool or Keepsake through an explicit transformation, but it begins as a separate category.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Special Artifact is a singular recovered object whose identity and provenance matter mechanically and which does not dissolve into Scrap.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Special Artifact is a singular recovered object whose identity and provenance matter mechanically and which does not dissolve into Scrap.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Adopted.**
atoms.normalized_claim: BSA-08B — Gathering Place is Adopted.

atoms.exact_source_text: Every Colony possesses a **Gathering Place**: the principal cultural and ceremonial Place where Citizens assemble to interpret their shared life.
atoms.normalized_claim: Every Colony possesses a Gathering Place: the principal cultural and ceremonial Place where Citizens assemble to interpret their shared life.

atoms.exact_source_text: Gathering Place is the universal functional term.
atoms.normalized_claim: Gathering Place is the universal functional term.

atoms.exact_source_text: It does not prescribe a circular plan, open ground, a single elevation, or another species-specific spatial form.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Gathering Place does not prescribe a circular plan, open ground, a single elevation, or another species-specific spatial form.
